_doc: The picks of the icons in the lines style (out_lines/, anima_gen.py --style lines), apart from the painted ones of picks_painted.json: `variant` — «<kind>/<id>»: n (absent — 1), written by pick.py on its tabs «· линии»; `same` — an icon laid from another's pick, as in picks_painted.json; `redraw` — the author's marks. Into the game only by choice: install.py --out tools/anima/out_lines --picks tools/anima/picks_lines_icons.json.
